table_name: NH3 Emission Factors from SR671 National Data (2023)
source: SR671: Forbedret grundlag for opgørelser af landbrugets emissioner
source_organization: Aarhus University, DCE - National Center for Miljø og Energi
description: NH3 emissions from livestock manure management (Husdyrgødning) - National average emission factors used for Danish GHG inventory reporting

units.årsdyr: kg NH3 per animal per year

notes: NH3 emissions are reported separately and NOT converted to CO2e equivalent
These factors include emissions from housing, storage, and field application
Based on Danish national inventory methodology aligned with IPCC guidelines
Factors vary by animal type, production system, and manure management

methodology_notes.calculation_scope: NH3 emissions from livestock manure management include:
not_included: Direct NH3 emissions from synthetic fertilizer application
Indirect NH3 emissions from crop residues
NH3 from grazing animals (included in housing factors)
methodology_notes.gwp_conversion: NH3 is NOT converted to CO2e - it contributes to acidification and eutrophication, not climate change directly
methodology_notes.reporting: NH3 is reported separately in kg NH3 for environmental footprint analysis

validation_notes: These factors match Danish national GHG inventory (NIR 2025)
Used for EU EEA reporting and UNFCCC submissions
Based on Danish-specific research and farm measurements
Updated annually by DCE Aarhus University
